content.text:
**Progress report**

Four composition-style features were tried. The clearest finding was that a spread between three-month changes in two flow rates, V02 versus V03, failed: its information coefficient was negative (about -0.06, t around -2), driven by the low-T regime. That reversal suggests the sign may be inverted, though this is unconfirmed.

Smoothed level compositions, using a ratio or a spread of six-month averages, were essentially zero (t below 0.3) and very persistent (rank autocorrelation about 0.96), so they add little.

The most promising feature was the short-horizon change spread between flow V04 and stock V06. Its IC was about 0.04 (t 1.57), with the same sign in both T regimes and low overlap with the base features.

Next, I will test sign reversal and variants that use changes rather than levels.
